description: This Kotlin file defines a Fragment class `ShareFragment` that enables users to select files, preview the selection, and share them via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi. It also includes AI enhancement features like predictive category chips, target device suggestions, and an inline assistant query. The class manages file picking, sharing intent creation, an AI UI for smart device and app suggestions, and interactions with the app's UI elements.

classes.name: ShareFragment
classes.description: A Fragment allowing users to pick files, preview them, and share via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi. Includes AI-enhanced UI elements for categorization and target suggestions, and interacts with system components for file selection and sharing.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up click listeners, and prepares AI UI elements.

methods.name: setupAiUi
methods.description: Configures the AI-enhanced UI, including category chips, predicted target chips, and assistant query field.

methods.name: addTargetChip
methods.description: Helper to add clickable chips for suggested targets or categories.

methods.name: openScan
methods.description: Opens a scanning fragment for nearby device detection.

methods.name: getSavedDeviceName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a saved device from preferences.

methods.name: getTopShareApps
methods.description: Returns a list of top share target apps or services, limited by specified count.

methods.name: openFilePickerWithType
methods.description: Launches system file picker with specified MIME type.

methods.name: confirmAndShare
methods.description: Shows confirmation dialog before executing share action and logs share history.

methods.name: shareViaBluetooth
methods.description: Shared selected files via Bluetooth app.

methods.name: shareViaWifi
methods.description: Shares selected files over Wi-Fi, defaulting to a generic intent.

methods.name: shareSelectedFiles
methods.description: Prepares and launches sharing intents for selected files, handling multiple files and optional package targeting.

methods.name: guessMimeType
methods.description: Attempts to determine MIME type for a given Uri.

methods.name: updateListState
methods.description: Updates the UI based on current file selection status.

methods.name: fileNameFromUri
methods.description: Retrieves the display filename from a Uri.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from file picker, updating selected URIs.
